answer: To resist Sybil attacks, consensus roots trust in transitive staking webs: like a living vine entwining verified peers, an agent’s voting weight swells only through organic attestations. A fleeting sparrow cannot feign flock-wide lineage, nor can synthetic replicas forge dense mutual roots. Validation weight scales sublinearly per node, imposing superlinear attacker cost as each fake identity faces an unyielding tide of verification proofs.
